description: K₃Na₃P₆Te(HO₄)₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3c space group. K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.61-2.91 Å. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.61 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.65 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. Te is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Te-O bond lengths are 1.94 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, two equivalent Na, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one K, one H, and one Te atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one K and two equivalent P atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one P atom.
